|game_text=Once per game, ▼ a device on Aurra. While armed with a [Reflections III] rifle, it may not be retargeted or stolen, her total weapon destiny is +1, and characters she hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 3 (or < 4 if armed with a rifle).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-01-Aurra_Sing_Deadly_Assassin-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text (see [[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of May 11, 2012"; this copy was re-made on 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Once per game may ▼ a device on Aurra. While armed with a [Reflections III] rifle: it may not be retargeted or stolen, her total weapon destiny is +1, and characters she hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 4 while armed with a rifle).” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-01-Aurra_Sing_Deadly_Assassin.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-aurrasingdeadlyassassin-pre.gif]]) print it. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) has “Once per game, ▼” (written out “deploy a device on Aurra from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”) instead of “Once per game may ▼”, “rifle, it” instead of “rifle: it” and “(or < 4 if armed with a rifle)” instead of “(< 4 while armed with a rifle)”<ref name="cl-1281_1-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]</ref>: “Once per game, ▼ a device on Aurra. While armed with a [Reflections III] rifle, it may not be retargeted or stolen, her total weapon destiny is +1, and characters she hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 3 (or < 4 if armed with a rifle).” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-01-Aurra_Sing_Deadly_Assassin-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
